item.title: SPIDER-MAN: BRAND NEW DAY Rumored To Feature The MCU Debut Of These Villains & A "Crazy Twist" - SPOILERS
item.description: We've heard that Spider-Man: Brand New Day will feature a lot of villains, and a new rumor claims to reveal the names of several of Spidey's foes that will make their MCU debuts...

item.title: WHISTLE Star Dafne Keen Responds To Fans Who Want To See X-23 Suit Up As MCU's Wolverine (Exclusive)
item.description: Talking to us about her phenomenal turn in the new horror movie Whistle, Dafne Keen reacts to the support she receives from fans to suit up as the Marvel Cinematic Universe's next Wolverine.

item.title: SUPERGIRL Puppy Bowl TV Spot And Poster Introduce Baby Krypto The Superdog
item.description: An extended TV spot for Supergirl has been released, and it introduces us to Krypto the Superdog as an adorable puppy. He also takes centre stage on a new poster for the DCU movie.

item.title: Alternate SPIDER-MAN: BRAND NEW DAY Trailer Description Leaks; Actor Playing Boomerang Possibly Revealed
item.description: A description for an alternate version of the Spider-Man: Brand New Day teaser trailer has leaked online, and it reveals The Scorpion design, organic webbing, and Peter Parker's reunion with MJ.

item.title: PROJECT HAIL MARY Final Trailer Takes Ryan Gosling An Epic Adventure With An Unexpected Passenger
item.description: With the Big Game about the start, Amazon MGM Studios have launched the final trailer for Project Hail Mary, offering a stunning new look at the upcoming Ryan Gosling-starrer and introducing his co-star!

item.title: SCREAM 7 Super Bowl Teaser: Ghostface Burns It All Down In New Look At Slasher Sequel
item.description: Paramount released a new teaser for Scream 7 during tonight's Super Bowl, and it finds Ghostface tormenting Sidney Prescott by targeting her teenage daughter, Tatum...

item.title: DISCLOSURE DAY Super Bowl TV Spot Reveals More About Steven Spielberg's UFO Movie
item.description: The Super Bowl TV spot for Disclosure Day has landed, and it reveals an exciting glimpse at what to expect from Steven Spielberg's still very mysterious UFO movie.

item.title: MINIONS & MONSTERS Trailer Reveals The Franchise's New Leads Causing Chaos In Hollywood
item.description: The first trailer and poster for Minions & Monsters was released during the Super Bowl, and the fan-favourite Despicable Me standouts are out to steal the show in Hollywood.
